verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
KRISTO,bw'atyo,bwe yeewayo
Ku lwaffe, ku muti;
Bwe tutyo naffe tweweeyo,
Okulokolebwa.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Omubiri gwe ye mmere
Eriisa-abeetaaga
Kigambo kye tekiggwaawo
Emirembe gyonna.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Otuliise-omubiri gwo
Tunywe-omusaayi gwo;
Nga bwe tusembera gy'oli
Tufune-obulamu.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Kitiibwa eri Kitaffe
Era neri-Omwana.
N'eri-Omwoyo-Omutukuvu
Emirembe gyonna.
